description: Purpose: a transparent compute-facility energy and cost estimate - IT load x PUE x hours (x tariff). Guidelines: supply it_power_kw; optionally pue (otherwise a published benchmark from the dataset is used and cited), hours (defaults to a full year) and electricity_price (without it only energy is returned). Limits: excludes non-cooling auxiliary loads, transmission losses, demand and capacity charges, green-power premia and carbon cost; the tariff must come from the caller. Ex: calculate_compute_energy_cost(it_power_kw=1000, electricity_price=0.6).

electricity_price.description: 电价（元/kWh）；不填则只返回用电量

hours.description: 运行时长（小时），默认 8760（全年）

pue.description: PUE（可选）；不填则取库内公开基准并标注来源

name: calculate_compute_energy_cost

text.description: Human-readable result (markdown, or a JSON string when response_format=json).
